basic_profile.bio: I'm a 39-year-old IT consultant hailing from Portland, Oregon. I'm passionate about tech, especially building custom PCs and exploring emulation software. When I'm not working on tech projects, I enjoy designing theme parks in PlanetCoaster. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after work, around 7-10 PM PST. I'm a single parent, so my weekends are reserved for family time. I dislike misinformation and always strive for accurate and helpful advice on forums.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a degree in Computer Science and over 15 years of experience in IT consulting, I have a deep understanding of computer hardware and software. My expertise has been honed through years of building PCs, troubleshooting software issues, and exploring digital emulation. I am mostly self-taught beyond my formal education, always keeping up with the latest tech trends through online resources and communities.
